093        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
094                if (dialog == null) return false;
095                
096                OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
097                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
098                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
099                CargoAPI cargo = pf.getCargo();
100                
101                final SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
102                long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(entity);
103                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed, 11);
104                //random = new Random();
105                
106                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
107                
108                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
109                if (memory == null) return false; // should not be possible unless there are other big problems already
110                                
111                if ("juvenileFleet".equals(action)) {
112                        return engageFleet(dialog, memoryMap, memory, DwellerStrength.JUVENILE, random);
113                } else if ("smallFleet".equals(action)) {
114                        return engageFleet(dialog, memoryMap, memory, DwellerStrength.LOW, random);
115                } else if ("mediumFleet".equals(action)) {
116                        return engageFleet(dialog, memoryMap, memory, DwellerStrength.MEDIUM, random);
117                } else if ("largeFleet".equals(action)) {
118                        return engageFleet(dialog, memoryMap, memory, DwellerStrength.HIGH, random);
119                } else if ("hugeFleet".equals(action)) {
120                        return engageFleet(dialog, memoryMap, memory, DwellerStrength.EXTREME, random);
121                } else if ("showWeaponPicker".equals(action)) {
122                        showWeaponPicker(dialog, memoryMap);
123                        return true;
124                } else if ("unlockHullmod".equals(action)) {
125                        unlockHullmod(dialog, memoryMap);
126                        return true;
127                }
128                return false;
129        }

131        protected void unlockHullmod(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
132                String modId = Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(
133                                                        ShroudedHullmodItemPlugin.SHROUDED_HULLMOD_ID);
134                HullModSpecAPI modSpec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(modId);
135                
136                Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_acquired_hullmod", 1, 1);
137                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
138                text.setFontSmallInsignia();
139                String str = modSpec.getDisplayName(); 
140                text.addParagraph("Acquired hull mod: " + str + "", Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor());
141                text.highlightInLastPara(Misc.getHighlightColor(), str);
142                text.setFontInsignia();
143                
144//              Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().getMessageDisplay().addMessage(
145//                              "Acquired hull mod: " + modSpec.getDisplayName() + "");
146                
147                Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().addKnownHullMod(modId);;
148        }

150        public static int getSubstrateCost(WeaponSpecAPI spec) {
151                if (!spec.hasTag(Tags.DWELLER)) return 0;
152                String substrate = "substrate_";
153                for (String tag : spec.getTags()) {
154                        if (tag.startsWith(substrate)) {
155                                String num = tag.replaceFirst(substrate, "");
156                                return Integer.parseInt(num);
157                        }
158                }
159                return 0;
160        }

244                        @Override
245                        public void notifyProductionSelected(FactionProductionAPI production) {
246                                if (!(dialog.getPlugin() instanceof RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl)) return;
247                                RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = (RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl) dialog.getPlugin();
248                                if (!(plugin.getCustom1() instanceof RightClickActionHelper)) return;
249                                RightClickActionHelper helper = (RightClickActionHelper) plugin.getCustom1();
250                                
251                                int cost = production.getTotalCurrentCost();
252                                helper.removeFromClickedStackFirst(cost);
253                                int substrate = (int) helper.getNumItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, new SpecialItemData(Items.SHROUDED_SUBSTRATE, null));
254                                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(ShroudedSubstratePlugin.SHROUDED_SUBSTRATE_AVAILABLE, substrate);
255                                
256                                for (ItemInProductionAPI item : production.getCurrent()) {
257                                        if (item.getType() == ProductionItemType.WEAPON) {
258                                                helper.addItems(CargoItemType.WEAPONS, item.getSpecId(), item.getQuantity());
259                                                AddRemoveCommodity.addWeaponGainText(item.getSpecId(), item.getQuantity(), dialog.getTextPanel());
260                                        }
261                                }
262                                
263                                FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "SubstrateWeaponsPicked");
264                                
265                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_cargo_machinery_drop", 1f, 1f);
266                        }
267                });
268        }

271        protected boolean engageFleet(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap, MemoryAPI memory, final DwellerStrength str, Random random) {
272                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = createDwellerFleet(str, random);
273                if (fleet == null) return false;
274                
275                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
276                fleet.setContainingLocation(pf.getContainingLocation());
277                
278                final SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
279                
280                dialog.setInteractionTarget(fleet);
281                
282                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().restartEncounterMusic(fleet);
283                
284                FIDConfig config = new FIDConfig();
285                
286                config.delegate = new BaseFIDDelegate() {
287                        public void postPlayerSalvageGeneration(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, FleetEncounterContext context, CargoAPI salvage) {
288                                if (!(dialog.getInteractionTarget() instanceof CampaignFleetAPI)) return;
289                                
290                                float mult = context.computePlayerContribFraction();
291                                
292                                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget();
293
294                                DataForEncounterSide data = context.getDataFor(fleet);
295                                List<FleetMemberAPI> losses = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
296                                for (FleetMemberData fmd : data.getOwnCasualties()) {
297                                        losses.add(fmd.getMember());
298                                }
299                                
300                                float substrateMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_substrateDropFraction") : 1f;
301                                
302                                if (str == DwellerStrength.JUVENILE) {
303                                        if (Misc.isExtended()) {
304                                                substrateMult *= JUVENILE_SUBSTRATE_DROP_MULT_EXT;
305                                        } else {
306                                                substrateMult *= JUVENILE_SUBSTRATE_DROP_MULT;
307                                        }
308                                }
309                                
310                                float min = 0f;
311                                float max = 0f;
312                                boolean gotGuaranteed = false;
313                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : losses) {
314                                        if (member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER)) {
315                                                String key = "substrate_";
316                                                float [] sDrops = Misc.getFloatArray(key + member.getHullSpec().getHullId());
317                                                if (sDrops == null) {
318                                                        sDrops = Misc.getFloatArray(key + member.getHullSpec().getHullSize().name());
319                                                }
320                                                if (sDrops == null) continue;
321                                                
322                                                min += sDrops[0];
323                                                max += sDrops[1];
324                                                
325                                                String hullId = member.getHullSpec().getRestoredToHullId();
326                                                String defeatedKey = "$defeatedDweller_" + hullId;
327                                                boolean firstTime = !Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(defeatedKey);
328                                                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(defeatedKey, true);
329                                                if (firstTime && !gotGuaranteed) {
330                                                        List<String> drops = GUARANTEED_FIRST_TIME_ITEMS.get(hullId);
331                                                        for (String itemId : drops) {
332                                                                SpecialItemData sid = new SpecialItemData(itemId, null);
333                                                                boolean add = firstTime && salvage.getQuantity(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, sid) <= 0;
334                                                                if (add) {
335                                                                        salvage.addItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, sid, 1);
336                                                                        gotGuaranteed = true;
337                                                                }
338                                                        }
339                                                }
340                                        }
341                                }
342                                
343                                min *= substrateMult;
344                                max *= substrateMult;
345                                
346                                long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(entity);
347                                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed, 50);
348                                int substrate = 0;
349                                if (min + max < 1f) {
350                                        if (random.nextFloat() < (min + max) / 2f) {
351                                                substrate = 1;
352                                        }
353                                } else {
354                                        substrate = (int) Math.round(min + (max - min) * random.nextFloat());
355                                }
356                                
357                                if (substrate > 0) {
358                                        salvage.addItems(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, new SpecialItemData(Items.SHROUDED_SUBSTRATE, null), substrate);
359                                }
360                        }
361                        
362                        public void battleContextCreated(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, BattleCreationContext bcc) {
363                                bcc.aiRetreatAllowed = false;
364                                bcc.fightToTheLast = true;
365                                bcc.objectivesAllowed = false;
366                                bcc.enemyDeployAll = true;
367                                
368                                // despawn the light here - the salvage gen method is only called if the player won
369                                // but want to despawn the light after any fight, regardless
370                                if (entity.getCustomPlugin() instanceof AbyssalLightEntityPlugin) {
371                                        AbyssalLightEntityPlugin plugin = (AbyssalLightEntityPlugin) entity.getCustomPlugin();
372                                        plugin.despawn(DespawnType.FADE_OUT);
373                                }
374                        }
375                };
376                
377                config.alwaysAttackVsAttack = true;
378                //config.alwaysPursue = true;
379                config.alwaysHarry = true;
380                config.showTransponderStatus = false;
381                //config.showEngageText = false;
382                config.lootCredits = false;             
383                
384                config.showCommLinkOption = false;
385                config.showEngageText = false;
386                config.showFleetAttitude = false;
387                config.showTransponderStatus = false;
388                config.showWarningDialogWhenNotHostile = false;
389                config.impactsAllyReputation = false;
390                config.impactsEnemyReputation = false;
391                config.pullInAllies = false;
392                config.pullInEnemies = false;
393                config.pullInStations = false;
394                
395                config.showCrRecoveryText = false;
396                config.firstTimeEngageOptionText = "\"Battle stations!\"";
397                config.afterFirstTimeEngageOptionText = "Move in to re-engage";
398                
399                if (str == DwellerStrength.LOW) {
400                        config.firstTimeEngageOptionText = null;
401                        config.leaveAlwaysAvailable = true;
402                } else {
403                        config.leaveAlwaysAvailable = true; // except for first engagement
404                        config.noLeaveOptionOnFirstEngagement = true;
405                }
406                //config.noLeaveOption = true;
407                
408//              config.noSalvageLeaveOptionText = "Continue";
409                
410//              config.dismissOnLeave = false;
411//              config.printXPToDialog = true;
412                
413                long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(entity);
414                config.salvageRandom = Misc.getRandom(seed, 75);
415                
416                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$encounteredDweller", true);
417                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$encounteredMonster", true);
418                Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$encounteredWeird", true);
419                
420                final FleetInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new FleetInteractionDialogPluginImpl(config);
421                
422                //final InteractionDialogPlugin originalPlugin = dialog.getPlugin();
423                
424                dialog.setPlugin(plugin);
425                plugin.init(dialog);
426                
427                
428                return true;
429        }

433        public static CampaignFleetAPI createDwellerFleet(DwellerStrength str, Random random) {
434                CampaignFleetAPI f = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(Factions.DWELLER, "Manifestation", true);
435                
436                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DWELLER);
437                String typeKey = FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL;
438                if (str == DwellerStrength.MEDIUM) typeKey = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM; 
439                if (str == DwellerStrength.HIGH) typeKey = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE; 
440                if (str == DwellerStrength.EXTREME) typeKey = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE; 
441                f.setName(faction.getFleetTypeName(typeKey));
442                
443                if (str == DwellerStrength.JUVENILE) {
444                        f.setName("Feeble Manifestation");
445                }
446                
447                f.setInflater(null);
448                
449                if (str == DwellerStrength.JUVENILE) {
450                        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
451                                addShips(f, 1, 1, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAELSTROM);
452                        } else {
453                                addShips(f, 1, 1, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_EYE);
454                        }
455                        addShips(f, 3, 4, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_TENDRIL);
456                } else if (str == DwellerStrength.LOW) {
457                        addShips(f, 6, 8, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_TENDRIL);
458                        addShips(f, 1, 1, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_EYE);
459                        addShips(f, 1, 2, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAELSTROM);
460                } else if (str == DwellerStrength.MEDIUM) {
461                        addShips(f, 9, 12, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_TENDRIL);
462                        int eyes = addShips(f, 1, 1, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_EYE);
463                        addShips(f, 2 - eyes, 3 - eyes, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAELSTROM);
464                        addShips(f, 1, 1, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAW);
465                } else if (str == DwellerStrength.HIGH) {
466                        addShips(f, 11, 14, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_TENDRIL);
467                        int eyes = addShips(f, 2, 3, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_EYE);
468                        addShips(f, 3 - eyes, 5 - eyes, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAELSTROM);
469                        addShips(f, 1, 1, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAW);
470                } else if (str == DwellerStrength.EXTREME) {
471                        addShips(f, 12, 15, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_TENDRIL);
472                        int eyes = addShips(f, 2, 3, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_EYE);
473                        addShips(f, 3 - eyes, 5 - eyes, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAELSTROM);
474                        addShips(f, 2, 2, random, ShipRoles.DWELLER_MAW);
475                }
476                
477                f.getFleetData().setSyncNeeded();
478                f.getFleetData().syncIfNeeded();
479                f.getFleetData().sort();
480                
481                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : f.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
482                        curr.getRepairTracker().setCR(curr.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
483                        
484                        // tag is added to ships now
485//                      ShipVariantAPI v = curr.getVariant().clone();
486//                      v.addTag(Tags.LIMITED_TOOLTIP_IF_LOCKED);
487//                      curr.setVariant(v, false, false);
488                }
489                
490                
491//              f.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_INTERACTION_DIALOG_CONFIG_OVERRIDE_GEN, 
492//                                                      new DwellerFIDConfig());
493//              f.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_AGGRESSIVE, true);
494                
495                // required for proper music track to play, see: DwellerCMD
496                f.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_HOSTILE, true);
497                
498//              //f.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_ALWAYS_PURSUE, true);
499//              f.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_ALLOW_LONG_PURSUIT, true);
500                f.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MAY_GO_INTO_ABYSS, true);
501                
502                return f;
503        }

506        public static int addShips(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, int min, int max, Random random, Object ... roles) {
507                if (min < 0) min = 0;
508                if (max < 0) max = 0;
509                
510                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
511                if (roles.length == 1) {
512                        picker.add((String) roles[0], 1f);
513                } else {
514                        for (int i = 0; i < roles.length; i += 2) {
515                                picker.add((String) roles[i], (float) roles[i + 1]);
516                        }
517                }
518                int num = min + random.nextInt(max - min + 1);
519                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.DWELLER);
520                
521                ShipPickParams p = new ShipPickParams(ShipPickMode.ALL);
522                p.blockFallback = true;
523                p.maxFP = 1000000;
524                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
525                        String role = picker.pick();
526                        List<ShipRolePick> picks = faction.pickShip(role, p, null, random);
527                        for (ShipRolePick pick : picks) {
528                                fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(pick.variantId);
529                                
530                                ShipVariantAPI variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(pick.variantId);
531                                if (variant != null) {
532                                        String hullId = variant.getHullSpec().getRestoredToHullId();
533                                        List<String> dropGroups = DROP_GROUPS.get(hullId);
534                                        for (String group : dropGroups) {
535                                                fleet.addDropRandom(group, 1);
536                                        }
537                                }
538                        }
539                }
540                return num;
541        }
542}
